0022600016.text: Boston, 3-1 overall, 3-0 at home, and on a three-game winning streak, hosts the 1-4 Chicago Bulls in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C game, with the Celtics second in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and third in the East, while the Bulls are 12th in the East and fourth in the Central, three games back, on a three-game losing streak. The Celtics lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 134-99 win in Boston on October 26, and they also won the 2025-26 series 2-1. Devin Carter is out for Boston with an illness, while Chicago is without Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury, and Dailyn Swain, Jalen Smith and Tobe Awaka are listed as day-to-day game-time decisions with back soreness, a finger injury and an ankle injury, respectively.
